title: Voyager 1 Runs on Less Memory Than One Phone Photo

scenes.text: Voyager 1 runs on less memory than a phone photo.
It launched in 1977, and it's still talking to Earth.
Its computers hold less than 70 kilobytes of memory.
One photo on your phone is many times bigger.
In 2023 it began sending unusable data. Engineers fixed it by moving code, from about 15 billion miles away.
Less memory than a photo. Still alive in space.

description:

Launched in 1977, each of its computers has about 70 kilobytes of memory, and engineers repaired it remotely in 2024.
